title: twice-made
author: toadbreath
tags: Jayce is in love with Viktor (League of Legends)

summary:
Three years ago, Piltover exiled its golden boy for the crime of studying magic. Now Jayce Talis fixes what Zaun breaks at the bottom of an alley, grease worked permanently under his nails, a beard grown in over the pristine face his city used to want — and every night, in a cellar beneath the floor, he builds the things they forbade him.
He does not mean to build a person. It happens anyway, on a night of bad weather, in a bloom of stolen light: a slender machine of steel and bronze who opens two golden eyes, looks down at Jayce’s bleeding hand, and observes, with great concern, “You are leaking.”
Viktor is the world’s first conscious android. He is also curiously, catastrophically illegal — fascinated by rain, hopeless with social convention, devoted to a small yellow toad, and, Jayce is beginning to fear, the best thing he has ever made. Now Jayce has to keep him hidden. From the customers. From the enforcers who take thinking machines apart in the street. From himself, and the one word he keeps not letting himself write down.

summary:
Arcano was a unique planet where two vastly different species managed to coexist, despite requiring different atmospheric compositions.
But the planet was dying.
Janna no longer answered the natives' pleas; meanwhile, as the human population dwindled rapidly due to an unknown disease, advanced technology revealed that extracting materials from the Na'vi fauna could yield a cure—and so, war broke out.
Jinx never cared much about it; Arcano was dying anyway. Furthermore, Janna’s disregard for pleas for mercy only deepened her disbelief. She felt no obligation to serve a goddess who was supposed to maintain balance yet turned her back on her people.
Humans and Na'vi were destined to slowly destroy one another, and she was under no compulsion to take sides; Jinx had already lost everything she had left, and she had already made her choice.

She wears green velvet.He lights forty-seven candles.In a forgotten ballroom, Powder learns to waltz — badly, with trembling hands, with a face split in two. For one night, she allows herself to be beautiful.
Across the city, Caitlyn Kiramman follows a signal. A stolen Hextech crystal. A secret engineer. She wears steel and carries the weight of justice on her shoulders.Vi follows Caitlyn. She doesn't know she is walking toward her sister's ghost. Seven years ago, Powder died in an explosion. Vi buried her. Vi mourned her.Vi never stopped looking.
The door opens.The waltz shatters.Somewhere between the candlelight and the cold stone corridors, two worlds collide.And Vi learns that the dead can come back — broken, scarred, alive, and not at all how she remembered.

title: Stay. Just for a While
author: JustDetalka
warnings: Creator Chose Not To Use Archive Warnings
tags: Powder Doesn't Become Jinx (Arcane: League of Legends)
summary:
One evening in Powder's room. She's fixing a music box. He comes after a Council meeting. They don't talk about the main thing — or they talk about everything except the main thing.
Seven years ago, Jayce Talis pulled her from burning Zaun. He gave her a home, an education, a job. He didn't give her freedom.
Powder lives in a gilded cage — with a face split in two, with a right hand that trembles when she's tired, and a right eye that never closes. She designs weapons for the family that saved her. She doesn't know if she's a traitor or just a survivor with no choice left.
Jayce is the heir to a military-industrial dynasty, the future head of the Council, a man who must marry the right girl from the right family. He comes to her room every evening. He doesn't say "I love you." Until tonight.
A story about two broken people trying to hold onto what they have, knowing that one day it will be taken from them. About fear that is stronger than love. And about love that doesn't know how to be happy — only how to live a centimetre away from a touch.
